lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration. Posterior to the gill slits, spots form organized vertical columns and horizontal rows with uniform spacing between the centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, forming a repetitive matrix of anchor nodes along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is observed along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a high-contrast gradient with high-intensity luminance on the superior edge and a shadow-based low-intensity gradient on the inferior edge.
